name: Calm Quest Pro
summary:
Don’t just go to therapy! Step into a living, responsive world where you are the architect of calm. **Calm Quest Pro** leverages cutting-edge heart-rate variability (HRV) biofeedback to let your own physiology sculpt the virtual landscape in real time. As your HRV stabilizes through mindful breathing, watch lush forests bloom, floods ebb, or magical books return to their places—each environment attuned to your inner state.
